# Outbound

> A live wallpaper for Mac. A painted landscape flies by behind your desktop, over eight real places. The light follows your clock, the seasons are real, and a little bird follows your cursor. $7 plus tax, once, for up to 3 Macs. Needs a Mac with Apple silicon and macOS 13 Ventura or later.

- Your Mac paints it live with Metal as it flies, so it never loops.
- The places: Punjab (India), Niigata (Japan), the Serengeti (Tanzania), Normandy (France), Lisse (Netherlands), La Pampa (Argentina), Lapland (Finland) and Kansas (United States).
- It pauses when the desktop is hidden, the screen sleeps or Low Power Mode is on. On battery it can hold a still painting instead.
- One landscape runs across every display. Your own wallpaper comes back when you quit.
- Updates are free and install themselves. No account and no analytics.

## Pages

- [Home](https://outbound.edbn.me/): what it looks like, the places, the price and the FAQ
- [Support](https://outbound.edbn.me/support): your key, moving to a new Mac, and help

- [License](https://outbound.edbn.me/license): the source is public to read; using the app needs a license
